Incoming groups remap reciprocal ties through actual reused slot generations.
Malformed later members and nonfinite used tie state reject atomically.
Nonzero native absolute IDs may repeat; metadata provenance stays distinct.
Imported metadata is owned by live robots and released on removal, instead of appended to an unbounded archive.
Saved Integer memory keeps -32768..32767; DNA stores retain native modulo-32000 semantics.
Desktop group save exports through the engine before showing the picker.
Zero-robot native .sim files now enter the production loader.
limits: Case counts overlap. These are focused checks, not the complete parity gate.
Full corpse state, offline native teleporters, native insertion placement and loaded control synchronization remain open.
